method: Heights above ground on a 1 m grid. core: dtcc-core city surface mesh roofs minus sample_surface.py's ground. osm: the basemap's render_height (OpenMapTiles: ceil(height, else levels x 3.66, else 5)); cells at exactly 5 m are treated as OSM having no height. lm: page 21's Lantmäteriet boxes (dtcc-core buildings). A core building needs OSM over 50% of its footprint to be compared. delta = core - osm, mean over cells where OSM has a height.
